categories.main_business_segments: E-Guardian Inc. operates a single business segment: Internet Security. This segment is further divided into five main service lines: Social Support (monitoring and customer support for social web services), Game Support (customer support, debugging, and localization for game companies), Ad Process (internet ad operations and compliance review), Cybersecurity (vulnerability assessment and WAF development/sales), and Other (mainly hardware debugging services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a hybrid approach combining AI and human expertise, particularly in content monitoring and security services. Proprietary systems such as E-Trident (monitoring), ROKASOLUTION (image filtering), and KiducooAI (object detection) are used, alongside in-house developed cloud-based and host-based Web Application Firewalls (WAF). Service delivery relies on workflow and sales management IT systems, with a focus on scalable, high-efficiency operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include operators of social web services, e-commerce and flea market platforms, fintech service providers, and game companies. Major clients are TikTok Pte. Ltd. and Mercari, which together accounted for approximately 25% of FY2025 sales. The company serves both domestic Japanese and international clients, with a focus on internet platforms, gaming, advertising, and enterprises requiring cybersecurity solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily based in Japan, with additional subsidiaries and service centers in the Philippines and Vietnam. Sales are mainly generated in Japan, but a significant portion also comes from Singapore and other overseas markets. The company maintains multiple service centers across major Japanese cities and has expanded its presence in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: E-Guardian operates downstream in the supply chain, providing end-to-end BPO and managed security services directly to internet service operators, game publishers, advertisers, and enterprises. The company acts as a service provider, delivering value-added solutions at the customer-facing end of the digital ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the core social support and cybersecurity businesses, strengthening AI-driven automation, and enhancing service quality through talent development. The company is actively pursuing M&A to broaden its service portfolio and scale, while deepening collaboration with its parent, Change Holdings, to target enterprise and public sector clients. R&D is focused on AI utilization for automation and advanced threat detection, as well as developing new security and BPO solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts based on volume (e.g., number of monitored posts, support cases, or processed ads), project-based fees for cybersecurity assessments, and product sales for WAF solutions. The company also earns from consulting, localization, and debugging services, with recurring revenue streams from ongoing BPO and managed security contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: E-Guardian faces competition from several domestic and international internet security and BPO providers, including firms with greater capital and broader customer bases. The company positions itself as a top-tier, comprehensive internet security vendor in Japan, leveraging its hybrid AI-human model and one-stop service capabilities. The market is expected to see increased competition from new entrants and larger players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥11.3 billion, with operating profit of ¥1.5 billion and net profit of ¥943 million. The company has a strong equity ratio (87.8%) and maintains high cash reserves. While revenue and profit declined slightly year-on-year due to large project fluctuations, the company has demonstrated stable growth over the past five years, with a focus on expanding high-value segments and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: E-Guardian differentiates itself through its hybrid AI and human operations, enabling high-quality, scalable, and efficient security and BPO services. The company emphasizes comprehensive, one-stop solutions for internet safety, rapid response to evolving threats, and deep expertise in both social media and cybersecurity. Its ability to tailor services to client needs and leverage proprietary technologies underpins its competitive advantage.
